patterns.pattern: Do you like + food? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
patterns.vi: Bạn có thích (món ăn) không? - Có, tớ thích. / Không, tớ không.

Do you like cheese? - No, I don't.
Do you like salad? - Yes, I do.

patterns.pattern: What food do you like? - I like + food.
patterns.vi: Bạn thích món ăn gì? - Tớ thích...
examples: What food do you like? - I like chicken and rice.
What food do you like? - I like fruits.

patterns.pattern: Is + food + healthy? - Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

grammar.title: Present Simple for Likes & Dislikes
grammar.explain_en: Use 'like' or 'likes' to talk about things you enjoy eating regularly.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'like' với I/you/we/they và 'likes' với he/she/it để nói về sở thích ăn uống.
examples: I like bananas.
He likes fresh apples.
We like healthy vegetables.

grammar.title: Linking Words: and, but, because
grammar.explain_en: Use 'and' to add ideas, 'but' for contrast, and 'because' to give reasons.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'and' (và) để thêm ý, 'but' (nhưng) để thể hiện sự trái ngược, 'because' (vì) để nêu lý do.
examples: I eat rice and chicken.
I like pizza, but it is not good to eat every day.
I drink milk because it makes me strong.
grammar.right: ✅ I drink water because I am thirsty.
grammar.wrong: ❌ I drink water but I am thirsty.

grammar.title: Present Continuous for Actions Now
grammar.explain_en: Use am/is/are + verb-ing to show what someone is eating or drinking right now.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng am/is/are + động từ-ing để tả hành động đang ăn hoặc uống ngay lúc này.
examples: Mai is eating an apple right now.
Ben and Tom are drinking water.
I am eating salad for lunch.

grammar.title: Can / Can't for Ability & Choice
grammar.explain_en: Use 'can' to show what you are able to eat or do for healthy living.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'can' (có thể) và 'can't' (không thể) để nói về thói quen ăn uống bạn có thể làm.
examples: I can eat five fresh fruits a day.
We can drink pure water every morning.
You can't eat cake all day.
grammar.wrong: ❌ I can to choose healthy snacks.

readings.title: AT THE SCHOOL CANTEEN
readings.text: It is twelve o'clock. Mai and her friends are at the primary school canteen. They are hungry and thirsty after morning classes. Look! Mai is eating a colorful salad with lettuce, cucumbers, and sweet carrots. She loves fresh vegetables because they are full of vitamins. Next to her, Tom is eating rice, eggs, and grilled fish. He is drinking a glass of cold milk. Mia is eating a red apple and smiling. They talk and laugh together. They know that eating fresh food every day keeps their bodies strong and healthy.

readings.title: A HEALTHY COOKING DAY AT HOME
readings.text: On Sunday morning, Linh and her brother Minh help their mother in the kitchen. They want to make a healthy family lunch together. Linh washes bright red tomatoes, crisp carrots, and green lettuce to prepare a big bowl of salad. Minh cooks white rice and boils fresh eggs in a small pot. Mother is grilling fresh fish on the stove. The kitchen smells delicious! Linh says, 'I love eating carrots because they are good for my eyes.' Minh agrees and adds, 'And fish makes our brain smart!' After cooking, the family sits at the warm dining table. They drink fresh fruit juice instead of sugary soft drinks. They enjoy their homemade meal very much because it is fresh, clean, and made with love.

classroom_game.name: HEALTHY FOOD TRAIN
steps_en: Step 1: Students stand in a big circle around the classroom.
Step 2: The teacher starts the train by saying: 'I am hungry! I want an apple.'
Step 3: The next student repeats and adds one healthy food: 'I want an apple and a banana.'
Step 4: Continue around the circle to build a long healthy food chain.
Step 5: If a student forgets a word or names an unhealthy food, they do five jump-jacks and start a new train!
steps_vi: Bước 1: Học sinh đứng thành một vòng tròn lớn quanh lớp học.
Bước 2: Giáo viên bắt đầu đoàn tàu bằng cách nói: 'I am hungry! I want an apple.'
Bước 3: Học sinh tiếp theo nhắc lại và thêm một món lành mạnh: 'I want an apple and a banana.'
Bước 4: Tiếp tục quanh vòng tròn để tạo thành chuỗi món ăn lành mạnh kéo dài.
Bước 5: Nếu học sinh quên từ hoặc nêu món không lành mạnh, bạn đó sẽ nhảy 5 cái và bắt đầu đoàn tàu mới!
